name: Fluidomat Limited
about: Fluidomat Limited manufactures and sells a range of fixed speed and variable speed fluid couplings for industrial and automotive drives in India. The company offers constant fill/fixed speed couplings, variable speed scoop couplings, FNCT fill-control fluid coupling, and FNIC for IC engines. It serves various industries, such as power plants, plant and machinery, steel, metal, cement, paper and pulp, chemical, fertilizers, and port and harbour. The company was founded in 1971 and is based in Dewas, India.
